sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Lestark is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II.

sections.title: In-Game Appearance
sections.content: Lestark appears as the major antagonist of Chapter 10 in Brave Frontier II, making his first appearance at Avulhein.

sections.title: Background
sections.content: Lestark is once a Disciple of the Gods who is in charge of protecting the "Tower" of Lizeria, it is unclear if the tower he is guarding refer to the Tower of Destruction in Brave Frontier. The former captain of the 26th Demon Slayers Division, Intellectus (needs correct translation). However, his true identity was not a human, but rather the Gods' Disciple in truth. Injured during the great war between the gods and humans, he caught a glimpse of humans slaughtering gods hundred of years later. As he witnessed the end of the age of the gods, he chooses to blend in with humanity and become a Summoner. Although Lestark controls the power of the gods, he was even called as the Legendary Summoner's reincarnation, yet his desire of revenge smolders deep within his heart. And then his opportunity came, he killed those who call him as allies and continued his battle against humans.

sections.title: Past
sections.content:
Holy Emperor Karna Masta, as the highest ranking God in the Lands of Grand Gaia, and the leader and most powerful of the Divine Ten, had commanded numerous disciples serving the gods. Lestark is one of them, though in that time he was low in rank. Despite his rank, Lestark was proud of the role he had been given of protecting the "Tower" of Lizeria, and he served as its guardian for many years. When the Great War broke out, he participated in the sweep of Lizeria as God Army's member. To him, the orders of the Holy Emperor were absolute, and he used his divine powers to the full extent to annihilate the humans. However, the resistance from the humans was greater than the gods could expected, and the God Army suffered great casualties; and Lestark is one of the army's member who was deeply wounded in the process. When he awoken after slumber to recover his wounds from the battle, he found out that Grand Gaia
is currently in a state where Maxwell, Cardes, Zevalhua and Afla Dilith were fighting for supremacy over Grand Gaia. He wandered around the chaos-ridden Grand Gaia, trying to gather information about where his master Karna Masta had gone in desperation. However, before he can learn the truth, the humanity he thought the gods have exterminated began to appear. He overheard the rumors of Sealed God Lucius had forced humanity to flee to the another world. But to his unexpectations, he never imagined that the latter would became the pawns of the Sealed God to invade Grand Gaia themselves. And then, humanity has exterminated the gods.

Lestark could not believe that one of the Divine Ten could be defeated by a mere human, until he learned the existence of Art of Summoning; the curse Karna Masta gave to the humans. Lucius was defeated by the summoners he himself led, and it was only that moment that the Holy Emperor had been sealed away in Ishgria. Without second thought, he headed to Ishgria to rescue his master, and there he found himself a horrifying situation: the humanity had defeated the Holy Emperor. Art of Summoning was far too dangerous for humans to use gods as their servants and defeating them would become the major subversive action to the laws of nature. Fortunately, Lestark's appearance was identical to that of a human, so he traveled to Elgaia through the Gate of Lucius created in order to learn about Art of Summoning. The fact that he was able to perceive the Gate created by Lucius meant that he too was capable of using the power of Summoning, an important fact that points to his past significantly.

Thus, Lestark disguised himself as a human and became a new member of Akras Summoner's Hall. He had a goal: to carry out the Holy Emperor's final command, to destroy humanity. Later, he came across to known and became comrade-in-arms with Nigel, Olivia, and Farbell as a part of their three divisions became known as "Terzetto", meaning "Trio". In that time, he is the captain of 26th Demon Slayers Division, Intellectus; and eventually created a bond with Sharon during his missions with Nigel, Olivia, and Farbell's division. Regrettably, Terzetto met its demise when Lestark killed Sharon, Farbell and Olivia with his own hands; the human named Lestark has gone, and the one standing before them is not Lestark they know, he is the Disciple of the Gods. With the power of Summoning in hand, he transcended humanity and ultimately carries Karna Masta's last command to eradicate humanity in order to complete his now-deceased master's endmost mission.

sections.title: Chapter 10: Inherited Thoughts
sections.content:
In Chapter 10, the final chapter of Brave Frontier II, Lestark made his first appearance at the Rainbow Bridge of Avulhein, seen clashing against the Legendary Summoner with Art of Summoning. After attempts of summoning that clashed with the latter's summoning, the both is near on the edge of going onto the real fight but is interrupted by Nigel, who came to Avulhein in order to avenge Sharon, Olivia, and Farbell for his actions of killing them. Lestark comments that Nigel is impolite to interrupt the battle, and mockingly asks the latter if something has happened after things changed since he last saw them, to Nigel's burning rage. He shows his irritation when he found the Summoner and Rin appeared at Avulhein as well, comparing the humans as pests as he stated they keep coming out in droves and plans to get rid of the both along with Nigel and Karl's group. He is revealed by Karl to be a former captain of Demon Slayers Division and further revealed by Roy that he used to be their and Akras Summoner's Hall's ally until the incident when he killed his own comrades 8 years ago; referring to Sharon, Olivia and Farbell. When Nigel asked him why he killed them, Lestark replies that the situation had become so bad that there was no longer any need to keep the three alive as they taught him more than enough about the human biological structures, and he is grateful for them including Nigel which further provokes the latter. Lestark then asks if Nigel has investigated the incident happened in Arturia from 8 years ago, and the latter learned that the former is the mastermind behind the murder of their comrades as well as his true identity as Gods' Disciple. He then tell Nigel that the latter knows what is he trying to do with the humans who are the plague to the world, which he reveals their entire existence must be wiped from all otherworlds; with the power of summoning that defeated the gods and made it his own and raised it to great extent, Lestark will grant the wish of the gods into realization. He is then came to the surprise when witnessing the power of bonds Summoner and Rin have, to Lestark's unexpectations of humans still possess such power but as a human, he must destroy even the smallest threats in the whole before summoning the warriors served under the gods to attack Summoner and Rin's group.

Realizing the might from power of bonds as Summoner and Rin defeat his summoned warriors, Karl confirms that humanity have many different powers within them. However, Lestark wishes to learn about the power of bonds but he has no more time to waste and stated that they shall perish while regretting being born as a human before Lugina tells everyone to prepare for a fight. Lestark then summons Creator Maxwell, Sealed God Lucius, and Holy Emperor Karna Masta, all three simultaneously; to the shock of the Summoners of Old and even Tilith herself including Rin's horror. As Rin asked who are they, Joshua reveals that their adversary summoned Creator Maxwell, Sealed God Lucius, and Holy Emperor Karna Masta whose all are powerful high-ranking gods. Lestark said that Legendary Summoner and his friends have even defeated a god but that only possible because the opponent was alone, and he is interested if they can continue to stand on the same way they did back then with everything facing against the gods before vanishing.

After the long battle against the summoned creator of the world, Tilith and Summoner uses their Xross Brave Burst to defeat the summoned Creator Maxwell once and for all, Lestark comments that such battle is a cheap farce. Nigel firmly replies that they too were like once, and he will not let his former comrade turned to archnemesis say that he had forgotten, Lestark only silents as Nigel tells him to take off those gloves if the former cannot remember which the latter reveals that the wound from that time is the scar he taken while protecting his comrades. This surprises Karl and Legendary Summoner as the former asks Nigel if that really happen, Nigel replies that it is the events when they striving to rose to command their own Demon Slayers Divisions and asks if he knew how Olivia felt when she was killed by him as she helped Lestark unaware that he is the mastermind of the murder. However, Lestark is unfazed and claims that humans are truly foolish for romanticize their memories and continue to cling on unreliable connections such as friendship; which at this point Karl grew aware that no matter how they try to convince, Lestark will be no longer persuaded by them as he disappears. Summoner, Rin and the others push forward and defeat Sealed God Lucius and Holy Emperor Karna Masta before they will confront Lestark.

When the group defeat the three gods summoned by Disciple of the Gods and confronts him, Lestark compliments in a mocking way that their determination is admirable to see that they are able to defeat Maxwell, Lucius and Karna Masta. Nigel furiously tells him to stop, but Lestark claims that his former comrade as fallen from grace for his nasty begging for his life which is typical for humans. Lestark became furious as Nigel protests before attacking him, Karl seen that he still resisting and Lugina commands Lestark to surrender himself quietly as the latter has no other way out; Lestark gives out a laugh that if he really had no way to turn back like Lugina said, he confidently said that even his summoned warriors are defeated, he can summon as many warriors as he wants to use as his pawns in battle. But this point, he summons Sharon, Olivia and Farbell, to Nigel's devastation as Lestark found his reaction as longing reunion come true while giving a point that the former could met him anytime if he had summoned him with his power of Summoning. Nigel is unable to do so and Lestark mocks that it is human's fragility, this infuriates Rin and his act is unforgivable. On the other hand, Lestark furiously stated that the ones who were unforgivable are the humans and state that despite they being fragile and weak, they defy the gods and rule the world as if it were their own world which that is extremely arrogant in his vision before declaring that the world can only maintain its beauty and balance when the gods are the ones who in rule. Tilith gives a point to Lestark it is true that humans are weak when compared to the gods, but they can maintain beauty and balance of the world as she wishes for him to understand, only to be seen by the latter as tempted by humans and now is the time for her to correct such mistakes before Karl and the company arrives as their prepare for a decisive battle. Lestark knew that it is time to decide it once and for all, telling them to come at him if they can harm their own comrades he summoned but Summoner and Rin insisted to fight Lestark as they will protect their friends. He claims that they are stupid and persistent as they keep repeating about friends and bonds, and he will make sure that such familiarity is useless before summoning more warriors to hinder them. Seria sarcastically gives that Lestark has a good attitude for using summoning powers to summon warriors in such timing, Lestark confirms that he can summon as much as he wants when Rin asks Tilith if their enemy has limits of their power before he claims that they will be perish by their own power of Summoning before retreating again. Karl and others take Summoner and Rin's place to fend off against the summoned warriors, telling them to fight alongside his friend; the latter then moves forward to settle the score.

At the Promised Land, Summoner and Rin along with Legendary Summoner go on to the final confrontation against Lestark, the Gods' Disciple found this not bad choice to send the people unfamiliar with Terzetto yet he gives a word that he understand their abilities better than anyone else and they will not be defeated so easily before commanding summoned Sharon, Farbell and Olivia to get rid the three. But his summoned comrades failed, Lestark took off his eyepatch as he decided to use all of his divine powers to eliminate Summoner, Rin, and Legendary Summoner once and for all. After a strenuous battle reaches its climax, Rin and the other two will end this battle while Lestark claims it is yet to be over before attacking the three but Nigel came in to end this himself, only to receive a fatal blow by Lestark and called as a fool. But Nigel stated that everything is for this very moment before he delivers a fatal blow to his former comrade, ending the decisive battle of avenging his friends. With the last of his strength, he mustered his comrade-in-arm's name, Nigel tells him to enough as he himself too receive fatal wounds after taking his blow, and Lestark fell onto his demise after.
